question: If the cost price is 66% of the selling price, then what is the profit percentage (correct to 2 decimal places)?
solution:
Given:

The cost price is 66% of the selling price

Formula Used:

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

Profit % = Profit/C.P. × 100

Calculations:

Let the Selling Price is 100x.

Then the Cost price = 66% of 100x

= 66x

⇒ Profit = 100x - 66x = 34x

⇒ Profit % = (34x/66x) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 51.52%

∴ The profit percentage is 51.52%
